question: After numerical repair, does loss of interpretable process information arise at full-system authorization, closure contrasts, cross-learner agreement, or spatial transfer?
taxa: exact first 10 frozen selection ranks; no exclusion or replacement

learners.preserved_raw_ridge: same raw-feature C=1 balanced L2 objective; previously tested transformed Newton, max100, gradient1e-12, decrement1e-9; verify two starts <=2e-6 prediction difference
learners.scaled_isotropic_ridge: StandardScaler trained within each training fold, balanced C=1 L2 logistic, newton-cholesky, max100, tol1e-10; convergence warning makes fit invalid

splits.spatial: exact three saved spatial GroupKFold train/test index arrays
splits.random_location: three-fold KFold(seed0,shuffle=true) on sorted unique frozen location_id; all records from one exact location remain together, with no label-guided split selection

location_grouping: restore location_id from frozen model-pool and nominal4000 training-background indices; verify joined predictor values/labels/row order exactly equal exported arrays before use
score: mean across folds of balanced presence-background log score; not true occurrence probability
closure_rule: remove every declared carrier of each process, keep all other predictors, refit same learner on identical folds; do not tune or prune remaining features
state_rule: original classify_process_state logic, margin0.01 and mean +/- 1 SEM across 3 folds (NOT a 95 percent confidence interval); unavailable if full-system gate fails; incomplete numerical fits cannot yield sharp states
primary_consensus: HGB and scaled isotropic ridge agree on same sharp state; keep all60 cells in denominator
secondary_consensus: HGB and objective-preserving raw ridge, and all three learners, reported without selecting best result
interpretation_limits: random-location interpolation is not spatial transfer
no true ecological process labels in real plants
shared or unregistered information proxies remain possible
single split realization and first10 panel cannot establish population-wide frequencies
cannot compare 71/80 synthetic positive recovery with 60-cell real diagnostic coverage as the same estimand
